name: open-dream-rsi
description: Dream-RSI learning loop for Claude Code: queue Python tasks with tests, pull verified recipes and curated lessons, run improvement cycles. The MCP server ships inside the plugin (stdlib only, no pip install); Claude Code prompts for the task-queue and memory paths when the plugin is enabled.

tasks_path.title: Task queue (tasks.json)
tasks_path.description: Absolute path to the tasks.json the dreamer works on

memory_path.title: Memory directory
memory_path.description: Absolute path of the --memory store (policies, recipes, lessons, trees)
